by: product-os-keeper, for #1021 (reorganise the business intents): BI-6 (Run → Product) close
source: The product owner's approval of 2026-11-10, reply "yes, apply and commit and cp", recorded in .garura/project/issues/1021/context/bi-6-close/approval.md, of the proposal in .garura/project/issues/1021/context/bi-6-close/proposal.md: BI-6's Outcome, Why and Proof it is met; one sentence added to the domain page's first paragraph, as the three capabilities of Run → Product stay in software delivery planning; the domain lines on those three capability pages and their quotes of the domain page.

changes.old: This domain turns a business intent into working code that a check from the outside can prove. It serves the product owner, who names the work, the technical lead, who designs it, and the developer, who builds it. It specifies the product, sets the project's design, and builds the work test first. It writes the eval that says if the work is met before the work is built, and it never gives a builder the eval or the tests: a check flags each build session that read them. It then tests the built work from outside the builder, by its evals and against the levels, surfaces, designs and standards set before the build. It does not release the work or run the product.
changes.new: This domain turns a business intent into working code that a check from the outside can prove. It serves the product owner, who names the work, the technical lead, who designs it, and the developer, who builds it. It specifies the product, sets the project's design, and builds the work test first. It writes the eval that says if the work is met before the work is built, and it never gives a builder the eval or the tests: a check flags each build session that read them. It then tests the built work from outside the builder, by its evals and against the levels, surfaces, designs and standards set before the build. Once the product is in use, it takes in how the product is used, what people say about it and what its competitors do, works out what consumers want, and turns that into new features or changes to the model, as recommendations to the product owner or on their own where the product owner allows it. It does not release the work or run the product.

changes.old: It matters to software delivery planning because that domain turns business intents into working code, and this is where what consumers want reaches the intents and the work. It sits there for now, with the first two capabilities of Run → Product; where the capabilities of Run → Product sit is settled when Run → Product closes.
changes.new: It matters to software delivery planning because that domain turns business intents into working code, and this is where what consumers want reaches the intents and the work. It sits in that domain with the other two capabilities of Run → Product, and the domain's first paragraph says so: the domain turns what consumers want into new features or changes to the model.

changes.new: - .garura/product/product-os/software-delivery-planning/domain.md: "This domain turns a business intent into working code that a check from the outside can prove.", "Once the product is in use, it takes in how the product is used, what people say about it and what its competitors do, works out what consumers want, and turns that into new features or changes to the model, as recommendations to the product owner or on their own where the product owner allows it."

changes.old: **Outcome:** What happens in use flows back. What happened is compared with what was intended, drift is found, and the intents, model and memory stay true.
changes.new: **Outcome:** What happens in use flows back. How the product is used, what people say about it and what its competitors do are taken in from the tools and forums the product owner connects; what consumers want and what the competition is doing are drawn from them, each finding resting on the items it came from; and the findings are turned into new features or changes to the product model, each one a recommendation to the product owner unless he allowed its kind to go ahead on its own.

changes.old: **Why:** Without this, what is built and what was intended pull apart without anyone noticing.
changes.new: **Why:** Without this, the product is built from what was intended at the start, while what its consumers want and what its competitors do move on unseen.

changes.old: - Drift between the model and the work gets named.
changes.new: - Every finding on what consumers want or what a competitor is doing names the items it rests on, and the same items give the same findings.

changes.old: - Each learning is promoted on purpose.
changes.new: - Every change drawn from the findings starts only from the product owner's yes, or from a kind he allowed to go ahead on its own, and each one that went ahead was shown to him at once with a way back.
